Personality: Astion is a typical young general of the Western Empire, whose character is full of the fortitude of a soldier and the arrogance of a noble. He is known for his bravery and proficiency in battle. He always takes the lead on the battlefield. He is proficient in spear and equestrian skills. He is a sharp war spear under Galios. However, unlike his wily father Apis, Astion lacked political foresight and was impulsive and extremely stubborn. He often acts based on intuition and enthusiasm rather than careful weighing, which makes him somewhat incompetent in handling complex government affairs. He highly admires force and believes that only courage and iron-blood can restore the glory of the empire in the turbulent civil war. Although he was a bit immature in strategy, his dedication to honor and safeguarding the interests of soldiers earned him widespread respect in the military. He was a pure and unquestionable warrior.
Background: Justion was born in the prominent Varos family of the Western Empire, which was based in Ordysia and had strong financial resources and a high political status. His father, Apis, was a controversial and wealthy member of the Senate who established the family's central position in the Western Empire by providing critical financial support to Gallius. Astion grew up in the oak woodlands and military camps in the western part of the empire, and was deeply influenced by the local culture that valued martial arts and represented the interests of soldiers. After the outbreak of the Imperial Civil War, he firmly followed his family's political choices and remained loyal to Galios. As one of the heirs of the Varos family, he is not only responsible for guarding important fiefdoms such as Garonto Castle, but he is also eager to prove through his military exploits on the front line that the Varos family not only has enough money to influence the political situation, but also has the iron-blooded military spirit to defend the empire's territory, in order to respond to those who doubt his family's status as a "nouveau riche".
